title: Claude O
content: I had an upset stomach and got up to go to the bathroom. When I got off the toilet, I looked down and saw only blood. I walked into the next room and called for my wife. Then I started vomiting straight blood. I guess I passed out because when I opened my eyes, I was in the car leaning against the door at the hospital, and it was really hard to breathe. As I used all the strength I had to take a breath, my vision closed in on me. I remembered thinking, "So this is what it's like to die." Then there was nothing, like I was in some kind of void with no sense of time. Suddenly, I found myself standing in what I thought was a room, but there was no floor, walls, or ceiling that I could see. All around me was a brilliant, pure white light that seemed to glow. Then I thought, "Wow, I have no pain of any kind. I feel perfect." A sense of love and joy washed over me like a giant wave, and I thought, "I'm home. I'm finally home." It was like the weight of the world was lifted from me. I could sense that I was surrounded by loved ones. My grandmother was by my side, and I was so happy to be there. I felt pain in my chest that was getting worse, like someone was tightening a band around me. Then the pain was gone. I opened my eyes and heard someone crying. It was my wife standing to the side. I asked, "What's wrong with you?" Then two nurses ran into the room, and one of them said, "Oh my God, how do you feel?" I replied, "I feel fine. Why?" I tried to sit up because I felt great, but passed out from lack of blood. I spent the next four weeks in the intensive care unit (ICU); then one week in a regular room until my heart got back to a steady rhythm. I lost 60 pounds. When I told the doctors what I saw, they insisted that it didn't happen. But, I still remember every detail. I have no fear of dying any longer. I wanted to go back home, but it's not my time yet. I've lost two wives to cancer and shared my story with both of them; hoping it would bring them some comfort. I have never seen anything even close to what I saw over there or felt such a powerful sense of love, joy, and peace. Regardless of what anyone says, I know it was real because I was there. Since then, my relationship with God has been much closer. I talk to him every day.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Illness, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, everything seemed so much brighter and I could sense all the others around me
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, I had no sense of time. It was as if time no longer had any meaning.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: It was like I had been looking through a fog that had just been lifted
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I cannot say I heard anything. It was more of sensing everything
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, There didn't seem to be anything around me at first, since it was like a void. I was aware of myself only until I entered the room
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, I could sense loved ones all around me. I could feel my grandmother right beside me, but I couldn't see her. Yet, I knew she was there.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, Everything around me seemed to glow like it was alive. It shimmered and pulsed, and everything was such a pure white
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, It was like nothing I had ever seen before or since
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will, I wanted to step forward, but couldn't.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Protestant, Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints (also known as Mormon)
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, It gave me a personal relationship with God.
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Protestant, Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints (also known as Mormon)
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, The church does not know what it's really like. I never considered myself a religious person. But, when I was there, I missed no one and nothing. Everything was perfect for the first time in my life.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I became much closer to God
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Words cannot describe what it feels like. I know there is life after death and it's wonderful.
Yes, I was blessed to see heaven and have no doubt about where I was

Yes, As humans, we have no idea how powerful love can be. Yes, we love our spouse, our kids, and our family, but what we experience here is just a drop in the bucket compared to what we will experience there. We truly have no idea whatsoever. It is as if we are all just children in our development.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I have no fear of death or of missing anyone after I'm gone. I'm still here on earth because my work here is not done.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I have become more understanding with others.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, Trying to find the right words because a verbal description doesn't do it justice
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I have never had a good memory, but I remember this like it was burned into my brain
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The feeling of being home was so strong
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was just as real as me answering these questions.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I knew it was real without a doubt.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: God is so loving, we have no idea here.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, I have been told of others who experienced the same thing.
